# Autkids

> Autkids is an Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) app designed to help autistic and non-speaking children communicate through cards with images, text, and AI-generated audio, in a safe and ad-free environment.

Autkids began as an academic research project at a university, with the goal of providing autistic children with a simpler and more accessible way to express themselves and connect with the world. Children use a simple and protected experience, while parents, caregivers, and professionals can configure content and monitor usage.

The app has not yet been released on the App Store or Google Play. Autkids is currently in its pre-launch stage, and visitors can join the waitlist to be notified when the app becomes available.

## Languages

Autkids is designed for multilingual use and currently supports:

- Portuguese (Brazil) — `pt-BR`
- English (United States) — `en-US`
- Spanish — `es-ES`

The app's communication content and interface are available in these languages, allowing families and professionals to use Autkids according to the child's language and communication needs.

The official website also provides content in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.autkids.com/): Overview of Autkids and its features, including a demonstration video and the launch waitlist.
- [Help Center](https://www.autkids.com/faq/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about the app, accounts, privacy and data security, compatible devices, and support.
- [About Us](https://www.autkids.com/about-us/about_us.html): The project's story, mission, vision, timeline, values, and team.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.autkids.com/privacy-policy/privacy.html): Information about how personal data and children's data are handled.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.autkids.com/terms-of-use/terms.html): Terms and conditions governing the use of the Autkids app and website.

## Audience

Autkids is intended for families of autistic children or children who need support with communication and daily routines. It is also designed for clinics, schools, and professionals who work with these children, including therapists, speech-language pathologists, and psychologists.
